name: ASCII Rain
desc: Cascading terminal glyph-columns of phosphor rain that periodically self-organize into a hidden word or glyph before dissolving back into digital noise.

density.doc: active column fraction + trail length + glyph grid density

scale.doc: glyph cell size (chunky vs fine rain)

hue.doc: phosphor hue (130 green, 90 lime, 190 cyan) — used by terminal style

reveal.doc: how strongly the hidden word/shape surfaces through the rain

style.doc: render discipline: green CRT phosphor / amber monochrome / dark ink dot-matrix on cream / false-color heat ramp / high-contrast white

act.doc: dramaturgy: storm (shapes surface on swells) / broadcast (shapes dominate) / decay (rain thins over sections)
